name: China Europe International Business School (CEIBS)

tuition_total.note: School states approx. USD 72,500. Covers teaching materials (excluding textbooks), campus internet and databases. 70% due on registration, 30% before end of Term 4. The page's wire-transfer reference says 'MBA 2028': intake label to re-check.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No mandatory fee listed beyond tuition. Application fee RMB 1,000 (or USD 180 for international applicants), non-refundable.

components.item: on-campus single dormitory room (incl. water, electricity, A/C, Wi-Fi)

living_budget_total.note: No full living budget published; only on-campus dormitory rent.

scholarship.note: 'More than 40%' of MBA 2028 students received financial aid. Named awards include Monthly Giving Scholarship RMB 100,000 (5/yr), He'an Education Fund RMB 100,000 (2/yr), Wu Jinglian Academic Fund up to 3 x RMB 100,000 (mainland need-based), Welly and Techking scholarships RMB 60,000; many fellowships with unstated amounts. Dishuiquan interest subsidy up to RMB 30,000 for foreign loan users. Average award not published.

guaranteed_cash.note: Annual guaranteed cash = base + other guaranteed compensation (median other guaranteed comp RMB 95,000, reported by 32 of 61).

signing_bonus.note: Not reported separately; 'other guaranteed compensation' median RMB 95,000.

internship_daily.note: Summer internship daily salary/allowance, mid-60% range RMB 200-500.

by_geography.sub: Other Asia Pacific (incl. HK & Taiwan, India, Japan, Singapore, Thailand)

country_change.note: International students: 60% placed in Mainland China, 20% Asia Pacific, 20% Europe & America; Chinese students: 88.5% Mainland China, 8.2% Asia Pacific, 3.3% Europe & America.

employment.notes: 117 graduates, 80 seeking employment; 90% received and accepted an offer within 3 months (72 accepted). Salary stats on 61 usable responses of 72 job-accepting graduates (84.7%). Industry, function and location salaries are MEDIAN ANNUAL GUARANTEED CASH (base + other guaranteed), not base salary; pairing of percentages and medians checked on the rendered PDF page 8. Employer list is alphabetical without hire counts (full-time and internship); names above are a selection. Ranges also published (e.g. Technology 210,000-910,000).

profile.note: MBA2025: 121 enrolled, 18.2% international, 29.3 avg age, 5.4 yrs experience, 46.3% women, GMAT mid-80% 640-740, 18 places of origin.

rankings_cited.note: School news release, 16 Feb 2026: '#1 in Asia for the tenth consecutive year and #8 globally'.

notes: Source PDF saved as research/sources/ceibs-career-report-2025.pdf (36 MB, 12 pages).
